import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartAtlasParamFree
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepChartRange

set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000
set_option autoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry
universe u

section RealJoin
variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]

noncomputable local instance instOCg : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
  [IsIntegral C.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsDominant pi]
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]

/-- FULLY INLINED JOIN. `rep` is the producer's own term applied; the carrier is
`divSchemeOver …`, not an opaque `D0`. Only `hrange`, `hf`, `hcov` are hypotheses. -/
noncomputable example
    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : ℕ)
    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    (r1 r2 : ℕ)
    (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
      ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
    (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
      ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
        ((windowM_choice pi hpi g + windowS_choice pi hpi g) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
    (hrange : ∀ (i : (Grassmannian.glueData k g r1).J)
        (j : (Grassmannian.glueData k g r2).J),
        ∃ F : DivFamZar C (DivCarveChartRing k
              (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
              (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
              (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j) pi g,
          (divRepClassifyZar hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2
              (DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
                (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
                (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j) F).left
            = divCarveChartToDivScheme k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
                (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
                (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j)
    (m0 : ℕ) (Z0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (hdeg0 : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z0
      = (m0 : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (g : ℤ))
    (V0 : (divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
        (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
        (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm)).left.Opens)
    (hf : ∀ i : PUnit.{u+1}, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf
      (mixedParamChart C pi (fun _ => g)
        (fun _ => divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
          (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
          (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm))
        (fun _ => divFunctor_representableBy_of_chartRange hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 hrange)
        (fun _ => m0) (fun _ => Z0) (fun _ => hdeg0) (fun _ => V0) i))
    [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology
      (Sigma.desc (mixedParamChart C pi (fun _ : PUnit.{u+1} => g)
        (fun _ => divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
          (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
          (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm))
        (fun _ => divFunctor_representableBy_of_chartRange hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 hrange)
        (fun _ => m0) (fun _ => Z0) (fun _ => hdeg0) (fun _ => V0)))] :
    (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy
      (Over.mk ((Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy hf).homEquiv
        (𝟙 (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).glued)).1) :=
  mixedParamRepresentableBy C pi (fun _ => g)
    (fun _ => divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
      (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
      (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm))
    (fun _ => divFunctor_representableBy_of_chartRange hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 hrange)
    (fun _ => m0) (fun _ => Z0) (fun _ => hdeg0) (fun _ => V0) hf

end RealJoin
end AlgebraicGeometry
